deviation: The submitted text is the termination article (Art. 12), not a confidentiality clause. It has no confidentiality obligation, use restriction, or 3-year post-termination period. Survival is only by article number (12.4), so Arcadia can't confirm that confidentiality survives for 3 years, or at all, and the wrong clause may have been submitted.
suggested_text: Add to 12.4: "Each party's obligations under Article [Confidentiality] shall survive termination or expiry of this Agreement for 3 years." Also confirm the actual confidentiality article contains: "Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information confidential, use it only for the purposes of this Agreement, and continue to do so for 3 years after the Agreement ends." (Fallback: minimum 2 years, with trade secrets protected indefinitely.)
